# Getting started

Install the tool, then pull your first package.

## Install the CLI

Download the release for your platform and put it on your `PATH`.

## Pull a package {#custom-anchor}

Run `ocx pull acme/gadget@latest` to fetch a pinned build.

Continue with [installing](./install.md#pinning-versions), the [store notes](./install), the
[CLI reference](../reference/cli.md?tab=flags#options) or the [guide home](./index.md).
Back to the [docs home](../index.md) or the [site root](/docs/guide/). See the
[spec](https://example.org/spec), [mail us](mailto:docs@example.org) or
[this section](#install-the-cli). A [diagram](./diagram.svg) is a file, not a page.
